recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the work group wants a stricter machine-enforceable no-compose constraint for rules-text, handle it in the Extension Pack or the external CRMI/THO profile-maintenance venue rather than changing current core under this historical STU3 issue.
issue_request: FHIR-18140 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Vocab issue asking FHIR core to support VSD non-computable Content Logical Definitions by adding a markdown ValueSet extension and a rule that the non-computable extension is used without a ValueSet.compose definition.
initial_application: The seed's Jira comment identifies git 66ae1e40f1bc02283363c872db14035fc795f8f7, which added a rules-text markdown ValueSet extension and narrowed valueset-expression to computable expressions with a rules-text cross-reference. The closely related FHIR-18135/FHIR-18710 commit 4907f9bcb0b710cb2837a93a20c4b23210a37249 had first introduced the broader expression-extension material.
additional_context: Later Vocab/VSDP records and FHIR-31489 confirm the intended split: valueset-expression is for computable expressions and valueset-rules-text is for non-computable human rules. FHIR-36015 added broader VSD ValueSet guidance, while FHIR-37959 intentionally removed the Shareable/Publishable/Computable/Executable ValueSet profile StructureDefinitions from core for external maintenance. Related issues FHIR-18710, FHIR-31489, FHIR-36015, and FHIR-37959 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active core ValueSet notes already link to valueset-expression and valueset-rules-text and describe rules-text as non-computable human-interpreted rules with no formal expression. The authoritative valueset-rules-text StructureDefinition is now in HL7/fhir-extensions as a ValueSet-context markdown extension, so reintroducing extension-definition source or removed profile constraints in core would be out of scope.
